name: web-monthly-returns-heatmap-grid-with-green-and-red-cells
title: Monthly returns heatmap: rows per year, cells tinted green for gains and red for losses, with yearly totals on the right
whatItIs: A white card titled 'Monthly returns' with a grey hint 'hover a month · year = compounded', a header row of month initials and 'Yr', five year rows ('21 to '25) of rounded square cells in soft green or red where stronger tints carry numbers (4, -4, 6, 7, -7) and a bold coloured yearly total (+14, -14, +32, -6, -8).
whatItMeans: Readable at a glance; tint intensity encodes size and colour encodes direction.
techniques: Tint cells by value in two hues.
Print numbers only in the strong cells.
Use rounded square cells with gaps.

vocabulary.definition: A grid whose cell colours encode values.
Two hues for positive and negative values.
A summary cell for a row.
The strength of colour showing magnitude.
